description: Lignes de bus is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ces données représentent le tracé des lignes de bus circulant sur le territoire de l'Eurométropole. Elle prend en compte les lignes de la Compagnie des Transports Strasbourgeois (CTS), mais également les lignes inter-urbaines et scolaires. La géométrie est celle du filaire de circulation de l'Eurométropole (base de donnée relationnelle en place dans le SIG métropolitain). Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are bus, CTS, filaire, Strasbourg. The portal shows 81 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
